evals.name: register-pet-slice
evals.expected_output: Creates lib/slices/register_pet/ with command.dart (RegisterPetCommand with petId and petName, value equality), state.dart, errors.dart (a PetAlreadyRegistered error), decider.dart (Decider that emits only PetRegisteredEvent and throws on an existing pet), repository.dart (EventRepository adapter that loads the pet stream by the petId tag), aggregate.dart, service.dart, dto.dart, handler.dart, serialization.dart, module.dart. Does not touch bounded-context folders. Tests in test/slices/register_pet/: one decider test per scenario, the error scenario expects the error and no emitted events, plus the determinism and fold-order property laws with @requires/@ensures comments. Does not create lib/state_change/. The screen has no kind, so it is a UI screen and gets UI code in ui/.

evals.name: missing-contracts-prerequisite
evals.expected_output: Notices that lib/bounded_contexts/clinic/api.dart and the event store port do not exist and that the events and field types are declared elsewhere in the model. Uses or asks for the full model and follows map-event-model-hcl-to-code to generate the shared contracts first, or tells the user what is missing. Does not invent field types or event definitions in the slice folder.

evals.name: lifecycle-api-screen
evals.expected_output: Creates lib/slices/confirm_booking/ (not lib/state_change/). state.dart holds a nullable BookingLifecycleState from the bounded context; evolve maps BookingOpenedEvent to open, BookingConfirmedEvent to confirmed, and BookingCanceledEvent to canceled. errors.dart has an error named after confirm_canceled_booking with the message 'A canceled booking cannot be confirmed.'; the decider throws it in the canceled state and otherwise emits only BookingConfirmedEvent. It invents no other lifecycle check and reports that the lifecycle states no rule for confirm_booking in the confirmed state or before the stream starts. repository.dart loads the booking stream by the bookingId tag of the aggregate identity. handler.dart holds the API route POST /bookings/{booking_id}/confirm because the screen kind is api; no ui/ folder. Tests in test/slices/confirm_booking/ group the scenario tests by case (happy_path, state_violation), and the state_violation scenario covers the invalid transition without a duplicate test.
